name: Jessica Massoletti
headline: Director of Professional Services @ Inobranch | Organizational Leadership
about:
As Director of Professional Services at Inobranch, I leverage over 8 years of experience in project and portfolio management to lead cross-functional teams delivering IT solutions for SMBs and enterprise level clients. Utilizing project methodologies, our team ensures seamless execution of complex projects while aligning contracts with organizational goals and standards.

In collaboration with diverse teams, I focus on optimizing implementation methodologies, streamlining processes, and fostering organizational change. With strong organizational leadership and time management skills, I am committed to driving impactful outcomes that enhance service quality and support the company’s mission in the IT sector.
… more

experiences.description:
Oversee a diverse portfolio and the project management office.
•	Assembled a talented team of Project Mangers, Coordinators, and Engineers to execute a portfolio of 90+ projects.
•	Interface with end-clients and reseller service partners to achieve successful implementations and desired project outcomes.
•	Developed and launched new CRM tool in 2023 that streamlined processes and overall project best practices.
•	Proactively manage KPIs.
•	Collaborate with the sales team to deliver expertise on deployment strategies, project staffing plans, and statement of work (SOW) estimates.
•	Serve on the SOW review team, and host lessons-learned session to improve overall deliverables.
•	Serve as an escalation point for projects, providing expert guidance to resolve issues and ensure successful outcomes.

• Directed a team of four Project Managers in a nationwide network deployment for a major automotive retailer, boosting project margins by 10% and increasing revenue from $900,000 to $1.3 million through effective change management.
• Implemented CRM tools to enhance client communications and analysis.
• Collaborated with vendors and partner companies to ensure project success and developed new practices for the Project Management Office.

• Led complex projects for SMB to enterprise-level clients, managing scope, risks, timelines, and budget effectively.
• Developed full-scale project plans and provided consistent implementation methodologies across all business units.
• Identified and managed project dependencies and critical paths, exceeding realization targets consistently.

• Partnered with regional and site-level leaders to identify hiring needs and develop strategic recruitment plans.
• Managed candidates across multiple functions, from front-line operations to salaried leadership roles.
• Built talent pipelines through job boards, community outreach, trade schools, and industry partnerships.

• Managed comprehensive case management and treatment coordination for patients at Northwest Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery.
• Advocated for patients, navigated care, and coordinated surgical scheduling, resulting in improved patient outcomes.
• Successfully obtained insurance pre-authorizations, coordinated benefits, and provided financial counseling for patients.
• Ensured compliance with HIPAA and regulatory guidelines, while building strong relationships with patients and interdisciplinary teams.

• Coordinated the Supplemental Instruction program, leading a team of 21 student teachers to enhance student engagement and participation.
• Managed faculty relationships and designed the program's website to increase program visibility and interaction.
• Implemented a real-time documentation system using Google Sheets, improving operational efficiency and web design skills.

• Led a team of writing tutors at Sam Houston State University, ensuring high-quality tutoring services.
• Developed and enhanced writing tutoring curriculum based on student needs and academic standards.
• Conducted one-on-one and group tutoring sessions focusing on grammar, structure, style, research, and citation.
